mutant.lineText: const codecFine = v !== undefined && profile.video.some((s) => s.codec === v.codec) && !videoReasons.some((x) => ['VideoCodecNotSupported', 'VideoProfileNotSupported', 'VideoLevelTooHigh', 'VideoBitDepthNotSupported'].includes(x.code));
mutant.prevText: // keep the source codec when the device takes it and only size, rate, bitrate or colour must change; otherwise the safest the device has
mutant.nextText: const targetCodec: VideoCodec = v !== undefined && codecFine ? v.codec : profile.video.some((s) => s.codec === 'h264') ? 'h264' : ((profile.video[0] as VideoSupport | undefined)?.codec ?? 'h264');
